observedIssues: Profile navigation rows had 17-point AX frames; center taps hit the empty spacer and did not navigate (4 new tests on both simulators).
On iPhone, app-wide upward swipes landed on the open keyboard, leaving the profile Save button offscreen. iPad settings scenario passed.
fixes: Make the whole 44-point profile navigation row a contentShape and assert its touch target in UI tests.
Done/focus dismissal for profile and calendar forms; scroll the actual scroll/collection view in UI tests.

observedIssues: SDK 18.5 marks AVAssetTrack non-Sendable; new MainActor hosted playback test could not await loadTracks across actor boundary. Both simulator jobs failed at compile, before tests.
fixes: Keep AVURLAsset and tracks inside nonisolated async metadata helper; return Sendable scalar metadata. Keep AVPlayer and playback time assertion on MainActor.
attempts.cancellation: After both simulator build failures were confirmed, pushing the fix cancelled the still-running package job under the existing concurrency policy.

observedIssues: Calendar confirmation test selected the covered calendar.cancel form button with the same title, instead of the dialog action (both simulators).
Screenshot review: recording 403 error was below the catalogue viewport; opening the fourth AAC row reused the catalogue scroll offset and hid detail title/back.
fixes: Select confirmation by label while excluding the underlying calendar.cancel identifier; wait for hittability.
Pin recording error above scroll content and scroll to top on selected recording change; assert error/title/back visibility in UI tests.
Capture both week header and scrolled hourly agenda as separate evidence.
attempts.nativeAACPlayback: PASS on both simulators; playability, audio track, duration and advancing AVPlayer time verified.

observedIssues: On iPhone, the system Passwords Save Password? window blocked 12 workflows after login. Failure videos show Not Now/Save; the app AX snapshot contains only an empty second fullscreen Window, so direct prompt queries return nil. Covered-child taps fail at scroll-to-visible before an event.
All 29 iPad tests passed; iPhone native AAC, recording detail navigation and profile/settings scenarios passed.
fixes: Register a narrowly scoped XCTest UI interruption monitor to decline only the known password-saving prompt; when a workspace target is covered, interact with the application surface to invoke interruption handling, then assert target hittability. Product password/autofill behavior is unchanged.

observedIssues: SDK 18.5 exposes the synchronous XCTest UI interruption monitor callback without a MainActor annotation. Access to MainActor-isolated XCUIElement properties and methods from that callback failed compilation in both simulator jobs, before tests executed.
fixes: Wrap the interruption callback's XCUIElement access in MainActor.assumeIsolated, checking its executor before reading or interacting with UI elements. Only the XCTest handler changed; product source remains unchanged.

observedIssues: The iPad runner failed during checkout: all three git fetch attempts could not connect to github.com:443, timing out after 75019, 75022 and 75023 ms. Checkout exited 128 before compilation or tests; no test artifacts were produced. This is an infrastructure failure, not an application/test result.

The iPhone run completed with 23 passed, 6 failed and 0 skipped. All six failures were existing workflows blocked at the login helper assertion that the workspace must be actionable; the narrow interruption handler did not reliably dismiss the system Passwords overlay. All five Stage 7 UI scenarios and hosted native AAC playback passed.

retry.reason: The earlier single-job retry request was rejected while the workflow was running. After iPhone also failed, no iPad retry of this unchanged source was performed; the DEBUG-only fixture input metadata fix is recorded separately by fixCommit.

fixes: Use .oneTimeCode text-content metadata for SecureField only in DEBUG launches with the explicit -uitesting argument, excluding OS Password AutoFill from deterministic fixture scenarios. Production password/autofill behavior is unchanged. Remove the ineffective UI interruption monitor and retain the post-login workspace hittability assertion.

observedIssues: The OS Passwords Save Password? overlay still appeared: DEBUG .oneTimeCode input metadata did not suppress it. Removing the 12-second login helper also allowed a late overlay to block even the first chat workflow.
The incoming-call fixture can present after login; choosing the generic workspace target risks a race with the call presentation.
fixes: Completely revert RootView to its original password input behavior. Restore bounded accessibility-based decline handling in XCTest, with a screenshot-grounded Vision OCR fallback only when the exact Save Password? and Not Now text matches have confidence at least 0.8 and the decline action is below the title.
Select the known incoming-call target using the explicit launch argument to avoid a late call-presentation race.
attempts.fixValidation: The OCR detector passed actual iPhone and iPad positive screenshots and two negative images. This detector check does not predict the next CI workflow outcome.
